steps.title: Prepare collagenase digestion solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.04 g collagenase A in 4 mL DMEM/F12‑HEPES. Then mix 4 mL of 10× collagenase stock with 26 mL DMEM/F12‑HEPES and add 10 mL BSA (fraction V) to obtain the digestion solution.

steps.title: Mince tissue in digestion solution
steps.instruction: In a 10 cm dish place a 1–3 cm tissue section, add approximately 5 mL of the digestion solution (DS), and mince with scalpels into ~1 mm³ pieces.

steps.title: Transfer and bring to volume
steps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue to a 50 mL conical tube and add DS up to a total volume of 35 mL (Q.S.) so the tissue is fully covered.

steps.title: Digest tissue at 37 °C (short)
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at 37 °C in a hybridization oven for 15–30 minutes (00:15:00‑00:30:00) with the rotator set to medium; optionally pipet up and down with a 5 mL pipette to aid digestion.

steps.title: Filter digested suspension
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm filter on a 50 mL conical tube, filter the suspension, grind remaining tissue with a syringe plunger flange, rinse the filter with DMEM, and re‑filter if necessary.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet cells
steps.instruction: Spin the filtered suspension at 430 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Remove adipocyte layer and store
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the top adipocyte layer and the supernatant. Store the adipocyte layer in 90 % DMSO / 10 % FBS for future analysis (adipocytes are >50 µm and unsuitable for 10X chips).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in DMEM
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL cold DMEM.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm FlowMi
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 40 µm FlowMi filter into a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells (first spin)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Perform RBC lysis (if needed)
steps.instruction: If red blood cells are visible, remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1× MACS RBC lysis buffer. Incubate on a nutating mixer at room temperature for 10 minutes (00:10:00) in 10–20 mL 1× buffer. Repeat up to two times, checking under a microscope after each lysis.

steps.title: Add DMEM and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 2× the volume of DMEM to the tube, then centrifuge at 4 °C, 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Resuspend in cold PBS
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL cold PBS.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm FlowMi (second)
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 40 µm FlowMi filter into a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Spin and wash cells
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00). After centrifugation, remove supernatant and wash cells with 1 mL cold PBS.

steps.title: Final wash and spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00) and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in PBS + 0.04 % BSA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in PBS containing 0.04 % BSA and adjust the cell concentration to 700–1200 cells/µL.

steps.title: Long digestion at 37 °C (12 h)
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell suspension at 37 °C in a hybridization oven for 12 hours (12:00:00) with the rotator set to medium; optionally pipet up and down with a 5 mL pipette during incubation.

steps.title: Filter after long digestion
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm filter on a 50 mL conical tube, filter the suspension, grind leftover tissue with a syringe plunger flange, rinse the filter with DMEM, and re‑filter if needed.

steps.title: Centrifuge after long digestion
steps.instruction: Spin the filtered suspension at 430 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Remove adipocyte layer (long)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the top adipocyte layer and the supernatant; store the adipocyte layer in 90 % DMSO / 10 % FBS if desired.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in DMEM (long)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the resulting cell pellet in 1 mL DMEM.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm FlowMi (long)
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 40 µm FlowMi filter into a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells (long)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: RBC lysis after long digestion
steps.instruction: If red blood cells are visible, remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1× MACS RBC lysis buffer. Incubate on a nutating mixer at room temperature for 10 minutes (00:10:00) in 10–20 mL 1× buffer; repeat up to two times, checking microscopically.

steps.title: Add DMEM and centrifuge (long)
steps.instruction: Add 2× the volume of DMEM to the tube and centrifuge at 4 °C, 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Resuspend in 1 µL cold PBS
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 1 µL cold PBS.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm FlowMi (final)
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 40 µm FlowMi filter into a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Spin and wash (final)
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00). After centrifugation, remove supernatant and wash cells with 1 mL cold PBS.

steps.title: Final wash and spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 300 ×g for 5 minutes (00:05:00) and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in PBS + 0.04 % BSA (final)
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in PBS containing 0.04 % BSA and adjust the concentration to 700–1200 cells/µL.
